thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started for release v2.3.1 at 2025-06-12T11:00:00Z. Rollout plan: canary 10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (15m). Change window: 11:00-11:45 UTC. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/12345

Alex Chen: Noted. Priya — can you prep a short status page blurb + an email template for dedicated/reserved customers? Flag: some dedicated pools may see short throughput warmup.

Priya Patel: Drafting now. Proposed status blurb:

"Scheduled maintenance: rolling deploy of runtime v2.3.1"
- Start: 2025-06-12 11:00 UTC
- Expected end: 2025-06-12 11:45 UTC
- Impact: Dedicated customers on reserved pools may experience brief latency increases or reduced throughput during pool warmup (typically <5 minutes). No data loss expected.
- Next steps: We're monitoring performance; if we detect sustained regressions on canary we will rollback affected pools and post updates here and on the status page. Contact: support@redwood.ai or +1-800-REDBOT for high-severity issues.

Samir Gupta: Suggestion: allow customers to opt to pin to v2.3.0 while we stabilize. Support should have a quick opt-out template and an engineering pin command. Proposed support template:
Subject: Action required: Optional pin to previous runtime during maintenance
Body: "We can pin your reserved pool to runtime v2.3.0 to avoid potential warmup impact. Reply to this thread or open a support ticket and we'll apply the pin immediately. Expected disruption: none."

Also add pin command to runbook: `redwoodctl pools pin --pool <pool-id> --runtime v2.3.0`

Alex Chen: OK. If canary 95th > baseline + 40ms we trigger an immediate rollback for affected pool(s). Maya / eng-sre, please set an alert and prepare the rollback runbook.

Maya Singh: On it. Adding alert: canary_95th_latency > baseline + 40ms for 3m. Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback steps
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/runtime --to-revision=2
redwoodctl traffic set --pool <pool-id> --runtime v2.3.0
# verify
redwoodctl metrics latency --pool <pool-id> --pct 95
```
I'll also add a PagerDuty escalation if rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: Canary started (10% traffic). 3m check-in: no errors, 95th = baseline + 2ms, CPU stable. :white_check_mark:

Priya Patel: Finalized status page copy and short email. pinging Alex + Maya for approvals.

Alex Chen: Approved. Schedule status update at 10:50 UTC and send email to dedicated customers 30 minutes before window. Use support@redwood.ai as reply-to. Also include opt-out/pin instructions.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% now for dedicated pools. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/12345

Maya Singh: Observed increase on dedicated-pool-7: canary 95th = baseline + 120ms, sustained 4m. Initiating rollback for pool-7, pinning to v2.3.0. Notifying support to inform customers.

support-bot: Status page updated: "Investigating increased latency for a subset of dedicated customers. We are rolling back affected pools to the previous runtime and will post an update shortly. Impact window remains 11:00-11:45 UTC."

Alex Chen: Good call. Keep comms concise. Priya, send an immediate targeted email to pool-7 contacts with this exact language and offer pinning to any other customers who want it.

Priya Patel: Sending now. Will paste email thread here once sent.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for pool-7; metrics trending back toward baseline. Continuing rollout for other pools with caution. :rocket:
